messages:
Maya: Anyone up for an early bike + pancakes Sunday? 7:30 AM at the waterfront picnic spot? 🚲🥞
Jamal: Ooh yes. 8:00 would be slightly more my speed — slow starter before coffee. ☕️
Maya: 7:30 is just a meetup time, people can roll in — folks who want to ride can start earlier. 8 works too if more people prefer.
Priya: I can do 7:30 if there's coffee after. I’ll bring a small stack of gluten-free pancakes (labelled). 🧺
Ken: I can bring a tiny propane griddle and a cooler. Also happy to ferry anyone from the north side. Car has space for bikes.
Lena: Sounds lovely. I have the community garden cleanup at 9AM though — might join for pancakes and then head over. Anyone want a pickup around 8:30?
Jamal: I can swing by Lena at 8:15 and drop you off near the garden if that helps.
Maya: @Lena that’d be perfect. Also dog-friendly — Luna is welcome. Dogs on leashes please. 🐶
Ken: Heads-up: I’ve got a small stack of vegan pancake mix too if anyone needs.
Priya: I’ll bring maple syrup and a little coffee thermos. Could someone grab disposable plates? I’ll try to bring real ones but just in case.
Jamal: Vote: 1) Early ride + pancakes, 2) Sleep in & brunch, 3) Cleanup + coffee. I’m 1 (but also 3 if we do both). :thumbsup:
Maya: 1) Early ride + pancakes — check
Lena: 3) Cleanup + coffee (leaning 3)
Ken: 1) Early ride + pancakes (and I can do the pickup)
Priya: 1 (& GF option)
Maya: OK looks like a majority for riding + pancakes; plan: meet 7:30 at the west end of the waterfront path, bring anything you want to share, we’ll aim to be out by 9 so folks can get to the garden if they’re doing that.
Jamal: Awesome. Quick logistics: there’s a small pay lot near the pier but street parking also. Bring layers, could be chilly.
Lena: Thanks y’all — might be split duty morning. See you if I can make it after the garden.
OpsBot: Reminder: Office cafe is closed Sunday for maintenance.
Maya: Sweet — see you Sunday! 🎒
thread_text_preview: Maya asks about early bike + pancakes, group coordinates times, GF and vegan options, pickup for Lena, OpsBot note about cafe closure
